description: An actual finite disjunction of ground equalities is true in a structure exactly when some equality on its list has equal actual term values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.equationDisjunction_truth.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (ps : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M] :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.equationDisjunction ps ↔
    ∃ p ∈ ps, FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim p.1 = FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim p.2
